title: Projektetage Resize Handles Alignment
description: Fix interactive resize on projektetage: content scales uniformly inside the frame (no text reflow overshoot); resize handles aligned with selection chrome.
summary:
Flow intro selection: handles and fill now share one ink box.

Root cause: selection fill painted the full `__content` block while resize chrome used section-space fractions as % of that parent — wrong coordinate space, so handles sat away from the blue fill.

- `measureDispositionBoundsInContainer` — ink bounds relative to the disposition wrapper.
- When flow + selected/dragging: position `__content` with `transformFrameStyle(inkInWrapper)` so the primary fill wraps the ink; chrome stays `inset: 0` on that same box (handles on fill corners).
- Wrapper `translate3d` still moves the whole unit on drag.

49 renderer tests pass.
